entities.name: Johannes Ciconia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Johannes Ciconia was an important Franco-Flemish composer and music theorist of trecento music during the late Medieval era. He was born in Liège, but worked most of his adult life in Italy, first in the papal entourage in Rome and later and most importantly at Padua Cathedral.
